description: Source file implementing font rendering utilities, including character classification (breakable, newline), glyph loading, rendering, kerning, and text layout functions within the 'teeui' namespace.

classes.name: TextFace
classes.description: Represents a font face object capable of setting character size, loading and rendering glyphs, and calculating glyph metrics and kerning.

methods.name: setCharSize
methods.description: Sets character size in points with specified DPI using FreeType.

methods.name: setCharSizeInPix
methods.description: Sets glyph size in pixels.

methods.name: getCharIndex
methods.description: Retrieves glyph index for a given Unicode code point.

methods.name: loadGlyph
methods.description: Loads glyph data for a given glyph index.

methods.name: renderGlyph
methods.description: Renders the loaded glyph into a bitmap.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Returns the glyph's advance width and height.

methods.name: kern
methods.description: Calculates kerning offset relative to previous glyph.

methods.name: getGlyphBBox
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the glyph.

classes.name: TextContext
classes.description: Represents a text rendering context, including initialization with FreeType library.

methods.name: bool isBreakable(unsigned long codePoint)
methods.description: Determines if a Unicode code point is a permissible line break character.

methods.name: bool isNewline(unsigned long codePoint)
methods.description: Checks if a Unicode code point is a newline character.

methods.name: std::tuple<Error,Box<pxs>,UTF8Range<const char * >> findLongestWordSequence(TextFace * face,const UTF8Range<const char * > & text,const Box<pxs> & boundingBox)
methods.description: Finds the longest sequence of characters in text that fits within a bounding box, considering glyph metrics and kerning.

methods.name: Error drawText(TextFace * face,const UTF8Range<const char * > & text,const PixelDrawer & drawPixel,PxPoint pen)
